mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, status, priority, category, display_order AS displayOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks ORDER BY display_order ASC, id DESC
SELECT id, title, description, status, priority, category, display_order AS displayOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks ( title, description, status, priority, category, display_order, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{category}, #{displayOrder}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, priority = #{priority}, category = #{category}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
